honest_notes: We have not published client case studies or references. If relevant experience exists for your project, we will describe it and share references only with the client's permission.
Every project starts with a written scope. We do not promise outcomes in advance; we agree how success will be measured.
AI systems can be wrong. We design for review, logging and fallbacks.
The outcomes described on this site are goals we design for, not guarantees. We agree how success will be measured before work starts.

process.text: You describe the problem. We reply by email if it looks like a fit. No obligation and no sales calls unless you ask for one.
We clarify goals, data, constraints and risks.
A written scope, timeline and price for you to review.
Iterative build with regular reviews and automated tests.
Code, documentation and a maintenance option.

custom-ai-agents.title: Custom AI Agents
custom-ai-agents.summary: AI agents that carry out a defined task with your data and tools, so repetitive work is done consistently and your team's time goes to higher-value work. Built with limits, logging and a person in control where it matters.
good_fit: Teams with a repeatable, rules-driven task that currently takes manual effort
Processes where a mistake is recoverable and can be reviewed
deliverables: Scoped design of the task, tools the agent may use and what it must never do
A working agent with logging and an approval step for risky actions
Evaluation on examples from your own process, with the failures reported
Handover notes and a maintenance plan
questions: What is the task, and what does a correct result look like?
Which systems must it read or change, and who owns them?
What happens when it is wrong or unsure?
custom-ai-agents.short: Digital team members that handle repetitive tasks, so your people focus on higher-value work.
outcomes: Less manual effort on repetitive, rules-driven tasks
Faster, more consistent execution of a defined process
Control and traceability: logging, limits and approval steps

ai-workflow-automation.title: Business Process Automation
ai-workflow-automation.summary: Automate multi-step work across the tools you already use, with AI only where it adds value, to reduce manual hand-offs, errors and turnaround time, with clear fallbacks to a person.
good_fit: Operations teams with multi-step, repetitive work across several systems
Companies that want fewer manual hand-offs without replacing their tools
deliverables: Process map and a decision on what should and should not be automated
Implemented workflow with error handling and alerts
Runbook for the people who operate it
questions: Which steps are manual today and how often do they run?
What are the exceptions?
Who is alerted when it fails?
ai-workflow-automation.short: Fewer manual hand-offs and errors by connecting the tools you already use.
outcomes: Shorter turnaround on repetitive multi-step work
Fewer errors from manual copying and hand-offs
Lower operating effort without replacing your existing tools

enterprise-ai-assistants.title: AI Chatbots & Assistants
enterprise-ai-assistants.summary: Chatbots and assistants for customers or employees that answer from approved company knowledge, respect access rules and say when they do not know, to take pressure off support and make answers faster to find.
good_fit: Organisations with documented knowledge that people struggle to find
Support and internal-help scenarios where answers must be traceable
deliverables: Requirements for sources, access control and tone
An assistant that cites the documents it used and declines questions outside its scope
Test set of real questions with measured answer quality
Monitoring and feedback loop
questions: Who may see which documents?
What are the ten questions it must answer well?
What must it refuse?
enterprise-ai-assistants.short: Customer and employee assistants that answer from your approved knowledge.
outcomes: Faster answers for customers and staff
Less repetitive load on support and internal-help teams
Traceable answers: the assistant cites the documents it used

custom-saas-applications.title: Custom Software Solutions
custom-saas-applications.summary: Web and business applications, with the backend services behind them, built around a specific process or product, from first release to a maintainable codebase that can grow with your business.
good_fit: Founders and businesses with a defined product or process
Teams that outgrew spreadsheets or off-the-shelf tools
deliverables: Scope and priorities for a first release
Working application with authentication, data model and admin tools
Automated tests for the critical paths and deployment instructions
Source code and documentation handed over
Backend services and APIs where the application needs them
questions: Who are the users and what must the first release do?
What existing systems must it integrate with?
What are the security and privacy requirements?
custom-saas-applications.short: Business applications and backend systems built around your process, ready to grow.
outcomes: Software that fits your process instead of forcing a workaround
A maintainable foundation that can scale with usage
Source code and documentation handed over to you

api-integrations.title: AI & Enterprise Integrations
api-integrations.summary: Reliable connections between your business systems, data and AI services (for example CRM, billing, support or partner platforms), so information flows without manual re-entry and your tools work as one.
good_fit: Businesses whose tools do not talk to each other
Products that need to connect to partner or customer systems
deliverables: Integration design covering data mapping, authentication and failure handling
Implemented and tested integration with logging
Documentation of limits, rate limits and error behaviour
questions: Which systems and APIs are involved?
What volume and latency are expected?
How should failures be handled?
api-integrations.short: Connect your systems, data and AI services so information flows without re-entry.
outcomes: Less duplicate data entry and fewer reconciliation errors
Faster hand-offs between teams and systems
Monitored connections with retries and logging

rag-document-intelligence.title: Data Analytics & AI Insights
rag-document-intelligence.summary: Turn your documents and business data into searchable, referenced answers, summaries and structured information, so decisions are made faster and on better evidence.
good_fit: Teams with large volumes of documents or records that cannot be reviewed by hand
Decision-makers who need evidence they can trace back to its source
deliverables: Review of your data sources, formats and quality
Ingestion and structuring pipeline for your documents and data
Retrieval and analysis with citations back to the source passage
Reports or views that present the findings to your team
An evaluation report that states where it fails
questions: What formats and volumes are involved?
How are documents updated or withdrawn?
How will correctness be checked?
rag-document-intelligence.short: Turn documents and business data into referenced answers, summaries and structured insights.
outcomes: Faster access to what your documents and data contain
Structured data extracted from unstructured files
Answers with references back to the source, so they can be checked

cloud-solutions.title: Cloud & Digital Transformation
cloud-solutions.summary: Cloud architecture, deployment and staged modernisation of ageing systems, designed for scalability, resilience and cost control, without a risky big-bang rewrite.
good_fit: Teams moving to or optimising cloud infrastructure
Products that need repeatable deployments and backups
deliverables: Architecture proposal with cost drivers explained
Infrastructure as code and deployment pipeline
Backup, restore and monitoring procedures tested with you
questions: Which cloud and compliance requirements apply?
What availability do you need?
Who will operate it afterwards?
cloud-solutions.short: Scalable, secure cloud foundations and staged modernisation of ageing systems.
outcomes: Infrastructure that scales with demand and recovers from failure
Cost drivers explained and kept under control
Modernisation in stages that keeps the business running

ai-consulting-strategy.title: AI Consulting & Strategy
ai-consulting-strategy.short: Find where AI pays off in your business, and where it does not, before you invest.
ai-consulting-strategy.summary: A practical review of where AI can and cannot help your business: use-case prioritisation, data readiness, risks and a written roadmap, so you invest in the right things and avoid the wrong ones.
outcomes: Clear priorities instead of scattered experiments
A realistic view of effort, risk and data readiness before you spend
A written roadmap you can act on, with or without us
good_fit: Leadership teams deciding where to start with AI
Organisations whose AI pilots have not reached production
deliverables: Discovery session on your goals, processes and constraints
Shortlist of AI use cases with expected benefit, effort and risk
Review of data and tooling readiness
Written roadmap and recommendation, including where an existing tool listed on AIHubpedia is the better answer
questions: Which business outcome matters most?
Which processes cost the most time today?
What data and systems are available, and who owns them?

ai-business-applications.title: AI-Powered Business Applications
ai-business-applications.summary: Applications where AI is a feature of a business workflow: classification, drafting, search or recommendations, with human review built in.
good_fit: Businesses adding AI capabilities to an existing process or product
Teams that need evaluation and guardrails, not just a demo
deliverables: Problem framing and success measures agreed before building
Application with AI components, evaluation on your data and a review step
Documentation of known limitations and monitoring plan
questions: What decision or task should the AI support?
What data is available and how sensitive is it?
How will we measure that it helps?
ai-business-applications.short: Applications where AI supports a business workflow, with review built in.
outcomes: Success measures agreed before building
Evaluation on your own data, not just a demo
Known limitations and monitoring documented

backend-development.title: Backend & API Engineering
backend-development.summary: Server-side services, databases and APIs designed for correctness, security and operations.
good_fit: Teams that need to extend or stabilise a backend
Products that need a clean API for web or mobile apps
deliverables: Service and data design reviewed with you
Implemented services with automated tests
Operational notes: configuration, backups, monitoring
questions: What does the system store and who may access it?
What load do you expect?
What is your hosting environment?
backend-development.short: Secure, dependable server-side services and APIs for your products.
outcomes: Services designed for correctness, security and operations
A clean API that web and mobile apps can rely on
Operational notes so your team can run it

software-modernization.title: Enterprise Software Modernisation
software-modernization.summary: Stepwise improvement of ageing applications: assessment, risk reduction, and incremental replacement rather than a risky rewrite.
good_fit: Organisations running critical software that is hard to change
Teams facing unsupported frameworks or fragile deployments
deliverables: Assessment of the current system, its risks and options, in writing
A staged plan that keeps the business running
Implemented first stage with tests around existing behaviour
questions: What does the system do and who depends on it?
What breaks or hurts today?
What constraints apply (compliance, downtime)?
software-modernization.short: Reduce the risk of critical, ageing software with stepwise improvement.
outcomes: Lower operational risk in critical software
A staged plan that keeps the business running
Tests around existing behaviour before anything changes
